title: habenaria iantha
intro: Habenaria iantha, commonly known as the white orchid, is a flowering plant species in the orchid family. It is a terrestrial orchid native to Southeast Asia, known for its unique white flowers. The health benefits of Habenaria iantha include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and its potential use in treating various health conditions.
